findings.body:
**Require completion evidence to postdate each switch.**

`validate_completed()` checks only the runtime fields and the order within the returned pair. Its `prior` argument is compared with `record["prior_runtime"]`, not with the completion log. Nothing rejects a completion that existed before the switch started. The paused-switch and switch-back checks already compare against a completion baseline, so the drain-harvest path is missing that guard.

The harvest proof can then accept an older pair in a switch record. Its final check at `apps/crq-python/ops/vm-unit-switch-guest.py:1017` requires only that the log grow by one entry across both switches.

Pass a baseline into the validator and reject sequences and invocation IDs that were already present before the switch:

```diff
-def validate_completed(record, runtime, prior):
+def validate_completed(record, runtime, prior, baseline):
     ...
     sequences = [item.get("sequence") for item in evidence]
     require(all(type(item) is int for item in sequences)
-            and sequences[0] < sequences[1],
+            and sequences[0] < sequences[1]
+            and min(sequences) > baseline["max_sequence"],
             "completion sequences are not strictly advancing")
     invocations = [item.get("invocation") for item in evidence]
     ...
     require(len(set(invocations)) == 2, "completion invocations are not distinct")
+    require(not set(invocations) & baseline["invocations"],
+            "completion invocations were already recorded before the switch")
```

Build `baseline` from `snapshot()["completions"]` immediately before each switch. Pass it at the `switch_phase()` call and both `drain_harvest_phase()` calls, at `:813`, `:983`, and `:1007`.
findings.title: Require completion evidence to postdate each switch.
